note: Original one-line descriptions written for this project by a model-author (claude-haiku-4-5) + adversarial-verify (claude-sonnet-5) workflow, 2026-07-15. Written from the models general knowledge anchored on the harvested signatures; NEVER copied from vendor documentation. A name absent here means the author abstained or the verifier rejected - absent beats wrong.

descriptions.abs: Returns the absolute value of the argument.
descriptions.acos: Returns the arc cosine of the argument in radians.
descriptions.adddate: Returns the date that results from adding the specified number of days to a date.
descriptions.addtime: Adds a time interval to a time or datetime value and returns the result.
descriptions.any_value: Returns an arbitrary value from the group; suppresses ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY constraint checks.
descriptions.ascii: Returns the numeric ASCII code value of the leftmost character in the string.
descriptions.asin: Returns the arc sine of the argument in radians.
descriptions.atan: Returns the arc tangent of the argument (or Y/X when two arguments given) in radians.
descriptions.atan2: Returns the arc tangent of Y/X in radians.
descriptions.avg: Returns the average value of a numeric expression over a row set.
descriptions.benchmark: Executes the expression repeatedly and returns zero, useful for timing operations.
descriptions.bin: Returns the binary string representation of the argument.
descriptions.bin_to_uuid: Converts a binary UUID to its text representation in standard UUID format.
descriptions.bit_and: Returns the bitwise AND of all values in a group.
descriptions.bit_count: Returns the number of set bits in the argument.
descriptions.bit_length: Returns the length of the argument in bits.
descriptions.bit_or: Returns the bitwise OR of all values in a group.
descriptions.bit_xor: Returns the bitwise XOR of all values in a group.
descriptions.cast: Converts the argument to a specified type.
descriptions.ceil: Returns the smallest integer value not less than the argument.
descriptions.ceiling: Returns the smallest integer value not less than the argument (synonym for CEIL).
descriptions.char_length: Returns the number of characters in the string argument.
descriptions.character_length: Returns the number of characters in the string argument (synonym for CHAR_LENGTH).
descriptions.charset: Returns the character set of the argument string.
descriptions.coalesce: Returns the first non-NULL value from the argument list.
descriptions.coercibility: Returns the collation coercibility value of the argument string.
descriptions.collation: Returns the collation of the argument string.
descriptions.compress: Compresses the string using the zlib algorithm and returns the compressed result as binary.
descriptions.concat: Concatenates the argument strings and returns the resulting string.
descriptions.concat_ws: Concatenates strings with a separator between each argument.
descriptions.connection_id: Returns the numeric identifier for the current connection.
descriptions.conv: Converts a number from one base to another and returns the result as a string.
descriptions.convert: Converts the argument to a specified type (equivalent to CAST).
descriptions.convert_tz: Converts a datetime value from one timezone to another.
descriptions.count: Returns the number of rows or non-NULL values in a set.
descriptions.crc32: Returns the CRC32 checksum value of the argument string.
descriptions.cume_dist: Returns the cumulative distribution of the current row within a partition over the result set.
descriptions.current_date: Returns the current date as DATE type.
descriptions.current_time: Returns the current time with optional fractional seconds precision.
descriptions.current_timestamp: Returns the current date and time with optional fractional seconds precision.
descriptions.current_user: Returns the current user's name and host as a string.
descriptions.curtime: Returns the current time with optional fractional seconds precision.
descriptions.database: Returns the name of the currently selected database.
descriptions.date: Extracts the date portion from a datetime or timestamp expression.
descriptions.date_format: Formats a date according to the specified format string.
descriptions.date_sub: Subtracts an interval from a date and returns the result.
descriptions.datediff: Returns the number of days between two date expressions.
descriptions.day: Returns the day of the month from a date as an integer between 1 and 31.
descriptions.dayname: Returns the name of the day of the week for a date.
descriptions.dayofmonth: Returns the day of the month from a date as an integer between 1 and 31.
descriptions.dayofweek: Returns the day of the week as an integer where 1 is Sunday and 7 is Saturday.
descriptions.dayofyear: Returns the day of the year from a date as an integer between 1 and 366.
descriptions.default: Returns the default value defined for a column.
descriptions.dense_rank: Returns the rank of the current row within its partition, with no gaps in ranking.
descriptions.elt: Returns the Nth element from a list of strings (1-based indexing).
descriptions.exp: Returns the mathematical constant e raised to the power of the argument.
descriptions.export_set: Returns a string representing bits in a binary value, with on/off strings for each bit.
descriptions.field: Returns the 1-based position of a string in a list, or 0 if not found.
descriptions.find_in_set: Returns the 1-based position of a string within a comma-separated list, or 0 if not found.
descriptions.first_value: Returns the first value in an ordered set of rows within a partition.
descriptions.floor: Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the argument.
descriptions.format: Formats a number with a specified number of decimal places using optional locale formatting.
descriptions.from_base64: Decodes a base64-encoded string and returns the result as a binary value.
descriptions.from_unixtime: Converts a Unix timestamp to a date or datetime, optionally formatted according to a format string.
descriptions.get_lock: Acquires a named advisory lock and returns 1 on success, 0 on timeout, or null on error.
descriptions.greatest: Returns the maximum value from a list of arguments.
descriptions.group_concat: Concatenates values from multiple rows in a group into a single string.
descriptions.hex: Returns the hexadecimal representation of a string or number.
descriptions.icu_version: Returns the version of the International Components for Unicode library.
descriptions.if: Returns the second argument if the condition is true, otherwise returns the third argument.
descriptions.ifnull: Returns the first argument if it is not null, otherwise returns the second argument.
descriptions.inet_aton: Converts an IPv4 address string to its numeric representation.
descriptions.inet_ntoa: Converts an IPv4 address from numeric representation to a string.
descriptions.inet6_aton: Converts an IPv6 address string to its binary representation.
descriptions.inet6_ntoa: Converts an IPv6 address from binary representation to a string.
descriptions.insert: Replaces a substring of specified length starting at a position with a new string.
descriptions.instr: Returns the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string.
descriptions.interval: Returns the index of the first argument value that is greater than the initial value.
descriptions.is_ipv4: Tests whether an expression represents a valid IPv4 address.
descriptions.is_ipv4_compat: Tests whether an IPv6 address is IPv4-compatible.
descriptions.is_ipv4_mapped: Tests whether an IPv6 address is IPv4-mapped.
descriptions.is_ipv6: Tests whether an expression represents a valid IPv6 address.
descriptions.is_used_lock: Returns the connection ID holding a named lock, or NULL if the lock is not held.
descriptions.is_uuid: Tests whether an expression represents a valid UUID.
descriptions.isnull: Returns 1 if the argument is NULL, 0 otherwise.
descriptions.json_arrayagg: Aggregates values into a JSON array by collecting each argument value.
descriptions.json_contains: Tests whether one JSON document is contained within another.
descriptions.json_depth: Returns the maximum depth of a JSON document.
descriptions.json_extract: Extracts data from a JSON document at the specified path or paths.
descriptions.json_length: Returns the length of a JSON document or a JSON element at a specified path.
descriptions.json_objectagg: Aggregates key-value pairs into a JSON object.
descriptions.json_overlaps: Tests whether two JSON documents have overlapping content.
descriptions.json_pretty: Returns a formatted version of a JSON document with indentation.
descriptions.json_quote: Quotes a string as a JSON string, escaping special characters.
descriptions.json_schema_valid: Tests whether a JSON document is valid according to a JSON schema.
descriptions.json_schema_validation_report: Returns a JSON report detailing validation errors for a document against a schema.
descriptions.json_storage_size: Returns the size in bytes of the storage space used by a JSON document.
descriptions.json_unquote: Unquotes a JSON string, removing outer quotes and interpreting escape sequences.
descriptions.json_valid: Tests whether an expression is valid JSON.
descriptions.json_value: Extracts a scalar JSON value from a document at the specified path, or NULL if not a scalar.
descriptions.lag: Accesses data from a row at a specified offset before the current row within a window.
descriptions.last_day: Returns the last day of the month for the given date.
descriptions.last_insert_id: Returns the value generated by an AUTO_INCREMENT column in the most recent insert.
descriptions.last_value: Returns the last value within the ordered window frame.
descriptions.lead: Accesses data from a row at a specified offset after the current row within a window.
descriptions.least: Returns the smallest value from a list of values.
descriptions.left: Returns the leftmost N characters of a string.
descriptions.ln: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.
descriptions.load_file: Reads and returns the contents of a file as a string.
descriptions.localtime: Returns the current date and time.
descriptions.localtimestamp: Returns the current date and time.
descriptions.locate: Returns the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string.
descriptions.log: Returns the logarithm of a number to a specified base, or the natural logarithm if no base is given.
descriptions.log10: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.
descriptions.log2: Returns the base-2 logarithm of a number.
descriptions.lower: Returns a string converted to lowercase.
descriptions.lpad: Returns a string padded on the left to a specified length.
descriptions.make_set: Returns a comma-separated string of values corresponding to the set bits in the first argument.
descriptions.makedate: Returns a date constructed from a year and a day-of-year value.
descriptions.maketime: Returns a time value constructed from hour, minute, and second arguments.
descriptions.max: Returns the maximum value from a set of values.
descriptions.md5: Returns the MD5 hash digest of a string.
descriptions.microsecond: Returns the microsecond component from a time or datetime value.
descriptions.mid: Returns a substring starting at a specified position.
descriptions.min: Returns the minimum value from a set of values.
descriptions.minute: Returns the minute component from a time or datetime value.
descriptions.mod: Returns the remainder when the first number is divided by the second.
descriptions.month: Returns the month component from a date value.
descriptions.monthname: Returns the full name of the month from a date value.
descriptions.name_const: Returns a value; used to associate a display name with an expression in result sets.
descriptions.now: Returns the current date and time.
descriptions.nth_value: Returns the nth value within a partition in a window function context.
descriptions.ntile: Divides rows into N approximately equal-sized groups in a window partition.
descriptions.nullif: Returns NULL if two expressions are equal, otherwise returns the first expression.
descriptions.oct: Returns the octal string representation of a number.
descriptions.octet_length: Returns the length of a string in bytes.
descriptions.percent_rank: Returns the relative rank of a row as a percentage within a partition.
descriptions.period_add: Adds a number of months to a period value and returns the result.
descriptions.period_diff: Returns the number of months between two period values.
descriptions.pi: Returns the value of pi, approximately 3.141593.
descriptions.pow: Returns a number raised to a specified power.
descriptions.power: Returns a number raised to a specified power.
descriptions.quarter: Returns the quarter (1-4) of a date value.
descriptions.radians: Converts an angle measurement from degrees to radians.
descriptions.rand: Returns a random floating-point value between 0 (inclusive) and 1 (exclusive).
descriptions.random_bytes: Generates a cryptographically secure random byte string of specified length.
descriptions.rank: Returns the rank of a row within a partition, with gaps for ties.
descriptions.regexp_instr: Returns the starting position of a substring matching a regular expression pattern.
descriptions.regexp_like: Tests whether a string matches a regular expression pattern, returning 1 or 0.
descriptions.regexp_replace: Replaces substrings matching a regular expression pattern with a replacement string.
descriptions.regexp_substr: Extracts the substring matching a regular expression pattern from a string.
descriptions.release_all_locks: Releases all named locks held by the current session acquired via GET_LOCK().
descriptions.release_lock: Releases a named lock previously acquired with GET_LOCK(), returning 1 on success.
descriptions.repeat: Returns a string repeated the specified number of times.
descriptions.replace: Replaces all occurrences of a substring with a replacement string.
descriptions.reverse: Returns a string with characters in reverse order.
descriptions.right: Returns the rightmost specified number of characters from a string.
descriptions.round: Rounds a number to the nearest integer or to a specified number of decimal places.
descriptions.row_number: Returns the sequential row number within a partition in a result set.
descriptions.rpad: Right-pads a string to the specified length with a padding string.
descriptions.rtrim: Removes trailing spaces from a string.
descriptions.schema: Returns the name of the current database selected for the session.
descriptions.sec_to_time: Converts a number of seconds to TIME format (HHH:MM:SS).
descriptions.second: Extracts the second component (0-59) from a time or datetime expression.
descriptions.session_user: Returns the user name and host of the current session (equivalent to USER()).
descriptions.sha: Computes the SHA-1 cryptographic hash of a string, returning a hexadecimal string.
descriptions.sha1: Computes the SHA-1 cryptographic hash of a string, returning a 40-character hexadecimal value.
descriptions.sha2: Computes the SHA-2 cryptographic hash (SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512) specified by hash_length.
descriptions.sign: Returns -1 for negative numbers, 0 for zero, and 1 for positive numbers.
descriptions.sin: Returns the sine of a value in radians.
descriptions.sleep: Pauses execution for the specified number of seconds, returning 0 on success.
descriptions.space: Returns a string consisting of the specified number of space characters.
descriptions.sqrt: Returns the square root of a non-negative number.
descriptions.stddev_pop: Returns the population standard deviation calculated over all values in a set.
descriptions.stddev_samp: Returns the sample standard deviation calculated over values in a set.
descriptions.strcmp: Compares two strings lexicographically, returning 0 if equal, negative if first is less, positive if greater.
descriptions.subdate: Returns a date with an interval subtracted from it.
descriptions.substr: Returns the substring of str starting at pos, optionally limited to len characters.
descriptions.substring: Returns the substring of str starting at pos, optionally limited to len characters.
descriptions.substring_index: Returns the substring before the nth occurrence of delimiter, or after if count is negative.
descriptions.subtime: Subtracts a time interval from expr1 and returns the result as a time or datetime.
descriptions.sysdate: Returns the current date and time at the moment of statement execution.
descriptions.tan: Returns the tangent of the angle argument in radians.
descriptions.time: Extracts the time portion of a datetime expression or converts an expression to a TIME value.
descriptions.time_format: Formats a time value according to the specified format string.
descriptions.time_to_sec: Returns the number of seconds from midnight for the given time value.
descriptions.timediff: Returns the time difference between two time or datetime expressions.
descriptions.timestampadd: Adds a time interval to a datetime value.
descriptions.timestampdiff: Returns the integer difference between two datetime values in the specified unit.
descriptions.to_base64: Encodes a string in base64 format.
descriptions.to_days: Converts a date to the number of days since year 0000.
descriptions.to_seconds: Converts a datetime to the number of seconds since year 0000.
descriptions.truncate: Truncates a number to D decimal places.
descriptions.uncompressed_length: Returns the length of a string before COMPRESS was applied to it.
descriptions.unhex: Converts a hexadecimal string to its binary representation.
descriptions.unix_timestamp: Returns the number of seconds since the Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).
descriptions.user: Returns the current user name and host connected to the database.
descriptions.utc_date: Returns the current date in UTC timezone.
descriptions.utc_time: Returns the current time in UTC timezone.
descriptions.utc_timestamp: Returns the current date and time in UTC timezone.
descriptions.uuid_short: Generates a short UUID as a 64-bit unsigned integer.
descriptions.uuid_to_bin: Converts a UUID string to a binary representation.
descriptions.validate_password_strength: Estimates the strength of a password (requires Validate Password plugin).
descriptions.values: In INSERT...ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, returns the value provided in the INSERT clause.
descriptions.var_pop: Calculates the population variance of an expression.
descriptions.var_samp: Calculates the sample variance of an expression.
descriptions.version: Returns the MySQL server version string.
descriptions.weekday: Returns the day-of-week index (0=Monday through 6=Sunday) for a date.
descriptions.weekofyear: Returns the week number (1-53) of a date using ISO 8601 conventions.
descriptions.year: Returns the year portion of a date as a four-digit integer.
descriptions.yearweek: Returns the year and week number combined as a six-digit integer (e.g., 202401 for week 1 of 2024), with optional mode parameter.
